title: GenXR-Bench: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Interactive XR Development
title_zh: GenXR-Bench：面向交互式XR开发的编程智能体基准

paragraphs.en: Coding agents are rapidly advancing from single-file generation to long-horizon repository-scale engineering, yet the evaluation of their capabilities in authoring interactive extended reality (XR) applications remains an open challenge. Unlike traditional software, XR applications operate within dynamic 3D physical environments where runtime robustness depends jointly on continuous user motion, spatial input, and environmental sensing. We introduce GenXR-Bench, the first benchmark for the end-to-end evaluation of coding agents in XR software development. GenXR-Bench contains 112 expert-authored tasks spanning 24 feature implementations, 21 bug repairs, and 67 application generation tasks. Held-out tests combine scripted and adaptive interactions with programmatic and visual assertions to evaluate core functionality and runtime behavior. GenXR-Bench’s testing suite achieves 96.5% accuracy against blinded expert judgments of 124 candidate applications executed on consumer XR hardware. Evaluating 10 models on GenXR-Bench, we find that the strongest configuration achieves only 50.9% overall Pass@1. Failure analysis identifies recurring misunderstandings in asynchronous sensor lifecycles, physical grounding, and embodied interaction semantics. GenXR-Bench establishes a reproducible testbed for evaluating coding agents in the interactive and physically situated conditions of spatial computing.
paragraphs.zh: 编程智能体正迅速从单文件生成迈向长周期的仓库级工程，但对其在编写交互式扩展现实（XR）应用方面能力的评估仍是一个开放性挑战。 与传统软件不同，XR 应用运行于动态的三维物理环境中，其运行时稳健性同时依赖于用户的连续运动、空间输入和环境感知。 我们提出 GenXR-Bench，这是首个用于对 XR 软件开发中的编程智能体进行端到端评估的基准。 GenXR-Bench 包含 112 个由专家编写的任务，涵盖 24 个功能实现任务、21 个缺陷修复任务和 67 个应用生成任务。 留出测试将脚本化与自适应交互相结合，并配合程序化断言和视觉断言，以评估核心功能与运行时行为。 在消费级 XR 硬件上执行的 124 个候选应用中，GenXR-Bench 的测试套件相对于盲评专家判断达到了 96.5% 的准确率。 通过在 GenXR-Bench 上评估 10 个模型，我们发现表现最强的配置整体 Pass@1 也仅为 50.9%。 失败分析揭示出智能体在异步传感器生命周期、物理接地和具身交互语义方面存在反复出现的误解。 GenXR-Bench 为在空间计算所特有的交互性与物理情境化条件下评估编程智能体建立了一个可复现的测试平台。

paragraphs.en: Coding agents have become increasingly capable of building interactive software. Recent benchmarks have expanded beyond algorithmic problems ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) to end-to-end interactive applications, evaluating how models handle dynamic user input in web and desktop environments ( Lu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Extended reality (XR) introduces a distinct set of challenges for code generation. Unlike 2D software governed by discrete event loops, XR applications operate within continuous 3D physical spaces. Functional correctness depends on the real-time coordination of head and hand kinematics, spatial coordinate transformations, environmental sensing, mixed-reality rendering, and physical ergonomics. Consequently, generating XR software requires reasoning about spatial mathematics, runtime sensor lifecycles, and embodied interaction semantics that are absent in flat-screen software engineering.
paragraphs.zh: 编码智能体在构建交互式软件方面的能力日益增强。 近期的基准测试已从算法问题（Jimenez 等，2024）扩展到端到端的交互式应用程序，评估模型在网页和桌面环境中如何处理动态用户输入（Lu 等，2025；Zhang 等，2025）。 扩展现实（XR）为代码生成带来了一系列独特的挑战。 与由离散事件循环主导的二维软件不同，XR 应用程序运行于连续的三维物理空间之中。 其功能正确性依赖于头部与手部运动学的实时协调、空间坐标变换、环境感知、混合现实渲染以及人体工程学。 因此，生成 XR 软件需要对空间数学、运行时传感器生命周期以及具身交互语义进行推理，而这些在平面屏幕软件工程中是不存在的。

paragraphs.en: Despite these demands, evaluating coding agents in XR remains largely unexplored due to an execution and verification bottleneck. Existing coding benchmarks rely on programmatic unit tests ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) or browser action runners ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , which cannot verify spatial scene graphs or continuous 3D tracking inputs. Conversely, 3D code-generation benchmarks focus primarily on generating static shapes rather than reactive software ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , while prior XR benchmarks focus on hardware performance and runtime systems rather than evaluating generative code synthesis ( Huzaifa et al., 2021 ; Bierbaum et al., 2003 ; Popescu et al., 2025 ) . Evaluating agent-generated XR software requires an automated and comprehensive testing suite capable of simulating physical environments, exercising embodied user actions, and verifying runtime behavior across diverse implementations.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管有这些需求，由于执行与验证的瓶颈，在 XR 中评估编码智能体仍在很大程度上未被探索。 现有的编码基准依赖程序化的单元测试（Jimenez et al., 2024）或浏览器动作执行器（Lu et al., 2025），这些方法无法验证空间场景图或连续的 3D 追踪输入。 相反，3D 代码生成基准主要关注生成静态形状而非响应式软件（Gao et al., 2026），而以往的 XR 基准则侧重于硬件性能与运行时系统，而非评估生成式代码合成（Huzaifa et al., 2021; Bierbaum et al., 2003; Popescu et al., 2025）。 评估智能体生成的 XR 软件需要一个自动化且全面的测试套件，能够模拟物理环境、执行具身用户动作，并在多种实现中验证运行时行为。

paragraphs.en: We present GenXR-Bench, the first benchmark for end-to-end evaluation of coding agents in XR software development. GenXR-Bench comprises 112 expert-curated tasks across two tiers: (1) SDK engineering tasks , consisting of 24 feature implementations and 21 bug repairs in core subsystems such as occlusion shaders, raycast reprojection, and gestural state machines; (2) Application generation tasks , consisting of 67 end-to-end experiences spanning education, healthcare, daily living, design, and entertainment, distilled from a taxonomy of 436 peer-reviewed XR systems papers. To support reproducible, headless execution without the proprietary GUI navigation and multi-gigabyte build toolchains of desktop game engines, all tasks are built on XR Blocks ( Li et al., 2025 ) , an open-source WebXR framework. To test candidate implementation at scale, we introduce GenXR-Test, the first set of testing tools that pair deterministic kinematic actors with adaptive VLM-controlled agents in simulated XR environments, evaluating runtime results through both scene-graph assertions and scoped visual checks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 GenXR-Bench，这是首个用于对 XR 软件开发中的智能体进行端到端评估的基准。 GenXR-Bench 包含 112 个由专家精心设计的任务，分为两个层级：（1）SDK 工程任务，包括遮挡着色器、射线投射重投影和手势状态机等核心子系统中的 24 个功能实现和 21 个缺陷修复；（2）应用生成任务，包括 67 个端到端体验，覆盖教育、医疗、日常生活、设计和娱乐领域，这些任务提炼自对 436 篇经同行评审的 XR 系统论文的分类体系。 为了支持无需桌面游戏引擎专有 GUI 导航和多 GB 构建工具链的可复现无头执行，所有任务均基于 XR Blocks（Li et al., 2025）构建，这是一个开源的 WebXR 框架。 为了大规模测试候选实现，我们引入 GenXR-Test，这是首套在模拟 XR 环境中将确定性运动学角色与自适应的 VLM 控制智能体相结合的测试工具，通过场景图断言和限定范围的视觉检查来评估运行时结果。

paragraphs.en: To validate our authored evaluation suite, eight blinded XR experts evaluated 124 candidate applications executed on consumer XR hardware. Across 372 evaluation runs, our automated suite achieved 96.5% mean accuracy against human expert ground truth with a 4.0% flakiness rate, demonstrating that simulator-based evaluation reliably reflects physical device execution. We evaluate 10 model configurations on the full benchmark. The strongest configuration achieves an overall Pass@1 of 50.9%, with performance dropping to 29.2% on SDK feature tasks. Diagnostic analysis reveals recurring failure modes across models: 64.4% of failed runs exhibit coordinate-transformation errors, 44.9% encounter asynchronous sensor initialization races, and 34.5% fail to distinguish bimanual interaction semantics.
paragraphs.zh: 为验证我们编写的评估套件，八位盲评的XR专家对124个在消费级XR硬件上运行的候选应用进行了评估。 在372次评估运行中，我们的自动化套件相对人类专家真值取得了96.5%的平均准确率，波动率为4.0%，这表明基于模拟器的评估能够可靠地反映物理设备的执行情况。 我们在完整基准上评估了10种模型配置。 表现最强的配置实现了50.9%的总体Pass@1，但在SDK功能任务上的性能下降至29.2%。 诊断分析揭示了各模型中反复出现的失败模式：64.4%的失败运行表现出坐标变换错误，44.9%遇到异步传感器初始化竞争问题，34.5%无法区分双手交互语义。

paragraphs.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 综上所述，我们的贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: GenXR-Bench : An open-source benchmark of 112 expert-authored tasks evaluating coding agents on XR software engineering, spanning SDK-level feature development, bug repair, and end-to-end application synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: GenXR-Bench：一个开源基准，包含 112 个由专家编写的任务，用于评估智能体在 XR 软件工程上的能力，涵盖 SDK 级别的功能开发、缺陷修复以及端到端应用合成。

paragraphs.en: Hardware-Grounded Validation : A validation study across 372 physical XR device trials demonstrating that simulator-based evaluation achieves 96.5% agreement with expert human judgment with low flakiness (4.0%).
paragraphs.zh: 基于硬件的验证：一项覆盖372次物理XR设备试验的验证研究表明，基于模拟器的评估与专家人工判断的一致性达到96.5%，且不稳定率较低（4.0%）。

paragraphs.en: Empirical Analysis of Coding Agents in XR : An evaluation of 10 model configurations identifying key bottlenecks in frontier models, including coordinate-frame handling, sensor lifecycles, and embodied interaction semantics.
paragraphs.zh: XR 编程智能体的实证分析：对 10 种模型配置的评估，识别出前沿模型的关键瓶颈，包括坐标系处理、传感器生命周期以及具身交互语义。

paragraphs.en: Interactive software often requires its own set of runtime evaluations. Recent agent benchmarks treat interactivity as the benchmark itself, using operating systems and interactive worlds to evaluate agents in controlled application environments ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Rawles et al., 2025 ; Trivedi et al., 2024 ; Koh et al., 2024 ) , while embodied-agent benchmarks similarly test long action sequences in fixed 3D environments ( Kolve et al., 2017 ; Puig et al., 2018 ; Savva et al., 2019 ; Shridhar et al., 2020 ) . Interactive software generation benchmarks often leverage these systems to evaluate generated software: website development benchmarks use agent-controlled browser actions to evaluate functionality ( Lu et al., 2025 ; Koh et al., 2024 ) ; ArtifactsBench ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , Interaction2Code ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) , and InteractScience ( Chen et al., 2026b ) combine runtime interaction and rendering with multimodal evaluations using vision-language models as judges ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) ; game-development benchmarks ( Chi et al., 2026 ; La et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ) combine functional, visual, and behavioral evaluations with interaction testing. GenXR-Bench extends runtime evaluations to XR software by simulating embodied interactions and environmental sensing to become the first benchmark to formalize evaluations of physically grounded interactive applications beyond relying purely on LLM judges. paragraphs.en: Natural-language 3D authoring predates coding agents, with early systems such as WordsEye ( Coyne and Sproat, 2001 ) and the framework proposed by Chang et al. (2014) translating text into virtual scenes. Recent approaches use language models to generate procedural content and interactive environments ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2024b ; Yang et al., 2024c ) . As a result, code-based 3D generation benchmarks increasingly extend evaluation beyond simple primitives to perceptually and physically correct models ( Gao et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Gu et al., 2025b ) . In XR, Text2VRScene ( Yin et al., 2024 ) and VRCopilot ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) allow users to use language to author new scenes and layouts. LLMR generates XR application features in real time ( De La Torre et al., 2024 ) ; DreamCodeVR generates object behaviors from speech within VR ( Giunchi et al., 2024 ) ; and LLMER produces structured specifications that control XR objects ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . GenAssist explores iterative agentic rendering loops to refine XR applications guided by human ratings ( Srinidhi et al., 2026 ) . XARP ( Caetano et al., 2026 ) and XR Blocks ( Li et al., 2025 ) introduce agent-native XR authoring toolkits for easy XR code generation. Closest to our work, Du et al. (2026) demonstrate that current LLMs can author XR applications that initialize without errors. GenXR-Bench continues this work, building upon the XR Blocks framework validated by Du et al. (2026) to systematically verify whether candidate implementations satisfy task-specific functional and interactive requirements across diverse XR development tasks.

paragraphs.en: XR presents unique evaluation challenges because runtime behaviors depend continuously on the user’s kinematics, physical environment, and spatial interaction dynamics ( Bowman et al., 2001 ) . Automated XR testing spans from replaying device input with state checkpoints ( Bierbaum et al., 2003 ) , categorizing WebXR ( Li et al., 2020 ) and Unity ( Rzig et al., 2023 ) bugs, and formalizing XR interface heuristics ( Nielsen and Molich, 1990 ; Gu et al., 2025a ; Utting et al., 2012 ) . The OpenXR Conformance Test Suite checks whether XR runtimes implement OpenXR interfaces consistently ( Khronos OpenXR Working Group, 2025 ) . VR-ReST derives functional tests from requirements and scene-graph structure ( Corrêa Souza et al., 2018 ) . Other work simulates user actions through camera-based exploration and scripted XR controllers ( Wang, 2022 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Gu and Rojas, 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) . XRintTest constructs an interaction-flow graph in existing Unity scenes ( Gu et al., 2026 ) . Commercial solutions such as Meta XR Operator ( Meta, 2026 ) integrate an LLM-driven tester into XR development to run natural-language tasks in Unity. Closest to our work are XR benchmarks that target end-to-end systems ( Huzaifa et al., 2021 ) , machine-learning workloads ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) , and performance criteria ( Popescu et al., 2025 ) . We extend prior works by introducing GenXR-Test, which empowers task authors to define implementation-agnostic functional tests executed deterministically within a reproducible simulator environment.
paragraphs.zh: XR 带来了独特的评估挑战，因为其运行时行为持续依赖于用户的运动学特征、物理环境以及空间交互动态（Bowman et al., 2001）。 自动化 XR 测试涵盖了从基于状态检查点回放设备输入（Bierbaum et al., 2003）、对 WebXR（Li et al., 2020）和 Unity（Rzig et al., 2023）缺陷进行分类，到将 XR 界面启发式准则形式化（Nielsen and Molich, 1990; Gu et al., 2025a; Utting et al., 2012）等多个方面。 OpenXR 一致性测试套件检查 XR 运行时是否一致地实现了 OpenXR 接口（Khronos OpenXR Working Group, 2025）。 VR-ReST 从需求和场景图结构中推导功能测试（Corrêa Souza et al., 2018）。 其他工作通过基于相机的探索和脚本化的 XR 控制器来模拟用户操作（Wang, 2022; Wang et al., 2023; Gu and Rojas, 2025; Zhu et al., 2025）。 XRintTest 在现有 Unity 场景中构建交互流程图（Gu et al., 2026）。 诸如 Meta XR Operator（Meta, 2026）之类的商业解决方案将 LLM 驱动的测试智能体集成到 XR 开发中，以在 Unity 中执行自然语言任务。 与我们工作最接近的是那些面向端到端系统（Huzaifa et al., 2021）、机器学习工作负载（Kwon et al., 2023）以及性能标准（Popescu et al., 2025）的 XR 基准测试。 我们通过引入 GenXR-Test 来扩展先前的工作，该工具使任务作者能够定义与实现无关的功能测试，并在可复现的模拟器环境中确定性地执行这些测试。

paragraphs.en: GenXR-Bench consists of 112 expert-curated XR software engineering tasks. Each task contains a natural-language specification, an editable project scaffold, and a held-out evaluation suite. The specification defines the required implementation and observable behavior. The scaffold provides the relevant code, tools, interfaces, documentation, and assets needed to complete the task. The evaluation suite contains human-authored tests written using GenXR-Test described in Section 3.4 .
paragraphs.zh: GenXR-Bench 由 112 个由专家精选的 XR 软件工程任务组成。 每个任务包含一份自然语言规格说明、一个可编辑的项目脚手架，以及一套留出的评估套件。 规格说明定义了所需的实现和可观察的行为。 脚手架提供了完成任务所需的相关代码、工具、接口、文档和资产。 评估套件包含由人工编写的测试，这些测试使用 3.4 节所述的 GenXR-Test 编写。

paragraphs.en: All tasks use XR Blocks 0.21.0 ( Li et al., 2025 ) , a web framework for building cross-platform XR applications. Prior work has demonstrated that LLMs can generate complete XR Blocks applications from a single prompt ( Du et al., 2026 ) . Using a common web framework reduces variation caused by engine-specific editors, deployment workflows, and device toolchains that often require complex GUI navigation. All agents were given access to XR Blocks DevTools, a suite of tools for debugging, running, and developing XR Blocks applications that simplifies multimodal development.

paragraphs.en: SDK feature implementation. Feature tasks require agents to implement a missing XR Blocks capability while retaining the surrounding SDK, interfaces, documentation, and relevant examples. Tasks cover capabilities such as hand interaction, sensing, spatial design, and rendering that form the primitive features for core XR development. These tasks are designed to evaluate an agent’s ability to implement and understand low-level XR functionality and focus on software engineering.
paragraphs.zh: SDK 功能实现。 功能任务要求智能体实现一个缺失的 XR Blocks 能力，同时保留周边的 SDK、接口、文档和相关示例。 这些任务涵盖手部交互、感知、空间设计和渲染等能力，它们构成了核心 XR 开发的基础功能。 这些任务旨在评估智能体实现和理解底层 XR 功能的能力，并侧重于软件工程。

paragraphs.en: SDK bug repair. Repair tasks begin with a snapshot of the XR Blocks SDK containing a reproduced behavioral issue. The specification describes the observable failure and required behavior without identifying the faulty implementation. Agents must locate and repair the defect while preserving related functionality.

paragraphs.en: SDK tasks. To source the SDK tasks, we interviewed core XR Blocks contributors and inspected all 552 pull requests and issues available as of August 24, 2026. Maintainer reports and pull requests were pooled into a candidate list of potential features and prior bugs, then filtered based on their relevance to XR engineering, evaluation feasibility, and scope. An author converted each selected candidate into a self-contained benchmark task. For feature tasks, the author removed the target implementation while retaining its public interface and context. For repair tasks, the author reproduced the selected defect in a pinned XR Blocks snapshot. SDK tasks contain both fail-to-pass tests for the target behavior and pass-to-pass tests for related behavior that test writers identified as potentially affected by candidate implementations. Authors were instructed to create adversarial solutions and conduct three rounds of test-suite refinement.
paragraphs.zh: SDK 任务。 为收集 SDK 任务，我们访谈了 XR Blocks 的核心贡献者，并审查了截至 2026 年 8 月 24 日的全部 552 个拉取请求和议题。 维护者报告和拉取请求被汇总为一份包含潜在特性和既有缺陷的候选列表，随后依据其与 XR 工程的相关性、评估可行性以及范围进行筛选。 一位作者将每个入选候选项转化为一个自包含的基准任务。 对于特性任务，作者移除了目标实现，同时保留其公开接口和相关上下文。 对于修复任务，作者在锁定的 XR Blocks 快照中复现了所选缺陷。 SDK 任务同时包含针对目标行为的 fail-to-pass 测试，以及针对相关行为的 pass-to-pass 测试，后者覆盖测试编写者认为可能受候选实现影响的行为。 作者被要求构建对抗性解决方案，并进行三轮测试套件精化。

paragraphs.en: Application tasks. We derived an application taxonomy from 436 XR systems papers published at top human-computer interaction and spatial computing venues. Using this taxonomy, gemini-3.5-flash generated 1,000 candidate application ideas. XR experts selected 67 candidates based on XR specificity, realism, implementation feasibility, and evaluation feasibility. Following Luo et al. (2026) , we expanded the selected ideas into full specifications using gemini-3.6-flash , manually reviewed and edited by XR experts. Appendix B describes the full procedure.

paragraphs.en: Authors then created an evaluation suite for each application task. Since there can be multiple valid implementations, we do not require a canonical reference solution. Authors refined each specification and evaluation suite using expert-reviewed valid and adversarial candidates, revising the task specification over up to 10 iterations. Tests were designed to assess the required interactive experience while accommodating differences between implementations.

paragraphs.en: GenXR-Bench contains 112 tasks consisting of 24 SDK feature implementations, 21 bug repairs, and 67 app generation tasks. XR experts rated 28 tasks as easy, 38 as medium, and 46 as hard based on subsystem breadth, interaction length, and expected implementation effort. Experts also assigned labels based on each task’s coverage of core XR capabilities, including interaction, user interfaces (UI), hand recognition, virtual object manipulation, depth sensing, object placement, perception, drawing, audio, and head tracking. A task could receive multiple capability labels depending on its scope. Figure 3 summarizes the task types and capability coverage.
paragraphs.zh: GenXR-Bench 包含 112 个任务，其中 24 个为 SDK 功能实现任务，21 个为缺陷修复任务，67 个为应用生成任务。 XR 专家基于子系统广度、交互长度和预期实现工作量，将 28 个任务评定为简单，38 个评定为中等，46 个评定为困难。 专家还根据每个任务对核心 XR 能力的覆盖情况进行标注，这些能力包括交互、用户界面（UI）、手部识别、虚拟对象操控、深度感知、对象放置、感知、绘图、音频和头部追踪。 一个任务可以根据其范围获得多个能力标签。 图 3 总结了任务类型与能力覆盖情况。

paragraphs.en: To build each evaluation suite, we introduce GenXR-Test, a set of testing tools for the creation of adaptive interaction tests. Each held-out evaluation suite combines actors that simulate user actions and environmental inputs with assertions that check the resulting application behavior. This allows tests to assess SDK implementations and generated applications under controlled runtime conditions. A custom simulator provides fully articulated hand inputs as well as various physical scenes and objects to simulate real-world XR environments. Figure 4 illustrates an example evaluation test. More information on the implementation of our evaluation suite can be found in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 为了构建每个评估套件，我们推出了 GenXR-Test，这是一套用于创建自适应交互测试的测试工具。 每个留出评估套件将模拟用户操作和环境输入的角色行为者与检查应用程序最终行为的断言相结合。 这使得测试能够在受控运行时条件下评估 SDK 实现和生成的应用程序。 一个自定义模拟器提供完全关节化的手部输入以及各种物理场景和物体，以模拟真实世界的 XR 环境。 图 4 展示了一个评估测试示例。 有关我们评估套件实现的更多信息，请参见附录 A。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Actors. Actors are testing functions that simulate head, hand, controller, gesture, object, environment, and time inputs. A scripted actor runs a predefined action sequence, such as performing a hand gesture, pressing a specified control, or following a path. Authors use scripted actors when the required action can be specified before execution, improving reproducibility and reducing variation in test execution. An adaptive actor is a VLM-powered agent that follows a narrowly scoped natural-language instruction when the required action cannot be reliably determined without knowledge of the candidate implementation, following prior work ( Lu et al., 2025 ) . For example, it may locate and activate a generated control or find an object needed for a later assertion. Authors use adaptive actors when differences in layout or interaction flow make fixed action sequences unreliable.
paragraphs.zh: 评估参与者（Actors）。 参与者是模拟头部、手部、控制器、手势、物体、环境和时间输入的测试函数。 脚本化参与者运行预定义的动作序列，例如执行某个手势、按下指定控件或沿路径移动。 当所需动作可以在执行前明确指定时，作者使用脚本化参与者，从而提高可复现性并减少测试执行中的变化。 自适应参与者是一个由 VLM 驱动的智能体，当在不了解候选实现的情况下无法可靠确定所需动作时，它会遵循范围狭窄的自然语言指令，这延续了先前的工作（Lu et al., 2025）。 例如，它可以定位并激活生成的控件，或找到后续断言所需的物体。 当布局或交互流程的差异使固定动作序列不可靠时，作者使用自适应参与者。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Assertions. After an actor produces a runtime state, assertions determine whether the required functional behavior has occurred. Programmatic assertions inspect runtime properties such as object transforms, spatial relationships, interaction state, collisions, tracking state, sensor outputs, and emitted events. For example, a test might check that a virtual object follows the hand and disappears upon colliding with a wall. Authors use programmatic assertions whenever the required behavior can be checked deterministically, focusing on observable outcomes to reduce flakiness ( Luo et al., 2014 ) . VLM-based assertions assess visual outcomes that are difficult to express directly as programmatic checks. Each assertion receives rendered images from the simulated user’s point of view and a narrowly scoped, human-authored criterion. These criteria describe an expected visual outcome rather than asking the VLM to judge the overall function of the experience, which limits judging failures. This design follows the findings of Cho et al. (2026) ; Huang et al. (2024) and is evaluated in Section 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 评估断言。 当智能体生成运行时状态后，断言用于判定所需的功能行为是否已经发生。 程序化断言会检查运行时属性，例如对象变换、空间关系、交互状态、碰撞、追踪状态、传感器输出以及发出的事件。 例如，一个测试可能会检查某个虚拟对象是否跟随手部移动，并在与墙壁碰撞后消失。 只要所需行为能够被确定性地检查，作者就会使用程序化断言，并聚焦于可观察的结果以减少不稳定性（Luo et al., 2014）。 基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的断言用于评估那些难以直接表达为程序化检查的视觉结果。 每个断言都会接收从模拟用户视角渲染的图像，以及一条范围严格限定、由人工撰写的评判标准。 这些标准描述的是预期的视觉结果，而不是要求视觉语言模型判断整个体验的整体功能，从而限制了评判失误。 这一设计遵循了 Cho et al. (2026)；Huang et al. (2024) 的研究发现，并在第 4 节中进行了评估。

paragraphs.en: Semantic Tags. Valid applications can use different identifiers and scene hierarchies for equivalent objects. Tasks in GenXR-Bench require evaluated coding agents to assign semantic tags to specified objects. Examples include controls, targets, and interactable objects. These tags allow actions and assertions to locate functionally equivalent objects without requiring a fixed implementation. Semantic roles are defined in the task specification and are limited to descriptions of the objects to be tagged, reducing the risk of exposing tests. Task authors are also explicitly instructed to limit the use of semantic tags to avoid forcing a single correct implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 语义标签。 有效的应用可以对等价对象使用不同的标识符和场景层级结构。 GenXR-Bench 中的任务要求被评估的编码智能体为指定对象分配语义标签。 示例包括控件、目标以及可交互对象。 这些标签使操作和断言能够定位功能等价的对象，而无需固定的实现方式。 语义角色在任务规范中定义，且仅限于对需要被打标签对象的描述，从而降低暴露测试的风险。 任务作者也被明确指示限制语义标签的使用，以避免强制采用单一的正确实现。

paragraphs.en: An application can satisfy its functional requirements while remaining difficult or uncomfortable to use. We therefore report a separate design score for application-generation tasks, following prior work in website generation ( Lu et al., 2025 ) . During test execution, we record videos of the evaluator running the candidate application and use a VLM as a judge to rate the application against ten XR design heuristics, each on a 1–5 Likert scale. The design score is intended to supplement functional evaluations. Details on the development of the XR heuristics and the alignment of the VLM judge with human evaluators are provided in Appendix C and Appendix E , respectively.

paragraphs.en: Eight XR experts participated in the evaluation. Each candidate received independent binary judgments of functional correctness from two evaluators, each of whom assessed the full functionality of the application. In cases of disagreement, a third independent evaluator re-examined the candidate and made the final decision. Evaluators were blind to the candidate source and verifier results and interacted freely with the application. For each candidate app, at least one evaluation used XR hardware (Galaxy XR, Meta Quest 3) to ensure alignment with real use cases.
paragraphs.zh: 八位 XR 专家参与了本次评估。 每个候选方案由两名评估员独立给出功能正确性的二元判断，每位评估员都评估了应用程序的完整功能。 在出现分歧的情况下，由第三位独立评估员重新检查该候选方案并做出最终决定。 评估员对候选方案的来源和验证器的结果不知情，并与应用程序进行自由交互。 对于每个候选应用，至少进行一次使用 XR 硬件（Galaxy XR、Meta Quest 3）的评估，以确保与真实使用场景保持一致。

paragraphs.en: We ran the automated evaluation suite three times for each candidate, producing 372 evaluation runs. As shown in Table 2 , the verifier aligns strongly with human evaluations (accuracy: 96.5%) and is reproducible (flakiness: 4.0%). These results indicate that the evaluation suite reliably reflects expert assessments of XR app functionality. paragraphs.en: XR development remains challenging even for frontier models. Across GenXR-Bench, XR development remains challenging even for frontier models, with the best performing model only reaching a Pass@1 of 50.9 ( claude-opus-5 ). XR functionality and design performance diverged where claude-opus-5 achieves the highest application-generation Pass@1 at 47.8%, while gpt-5.6-sol achieves the highest mean Design Score at 4.03. Notably, while SDK repair scores were high, SDK implementation and application-generation scores remained low, indicating that behavioral repair and bug identification pose a far easier challenge than end-to-end XR app implementation. Models further from the frontier were far less capable, failing on foundational spatial-computing concepts or completely unable to create core application objects. These smaller models suffer heavily from web development coding hallucinations, poor metric understanding, and API hallucinations. Frontier models are more capable of avoiding these errors but still fail at higher-order spatial reasoning, including bimanual coordination ( Figure 12 ), room geometry visualizations ( Figure 13 ), and physical alignment ( Figure 14 ).
paragraphs.zh: 即使对于前沿模型而言，XR 开发仍然具有挑战性。 在 GenXR-Bench 中，XR 开发即使对前沿模型来说也仍然具有挑战性，表现最好的模型仅达到 50.9 的 Pass@1（claude-opus-5）。 XR 功能与设计表现出现分化：claude-opus-5 在应用生成 Pass@1 上以 47.8% 取得最高分，而 gpt-5.6-sol 以 4.03 的平均设计得分（Design Score）取得最高分。 值得注意的是，尽管 SDK 修复得分较高，但 SDK 实现和应用生成得分仍然偏低，这表明行为修复和错误识别比端到端的 XR 应用实现要容易得多。 距离前沿较远的模型能力明显更弱，在基础的空间计算概念上失败，或完全无法创建核心应用对象。 这些较小的模型严重受到 Web 开发代码幻觉、指标理解能力差以及 API 幻觉的困扰。 前沿模型更有能力避免这些错误，但在更高阶的空间推理上仍然失败，包括双手协调（图 12）、房间几何可视化（图 13）以及物理一致性（图 14）。

paragraphs.en: Asynchronous initialization and environmental updates. Startup race conditions occurred in 44.9% of failed runs. Implementations began gameplay updates or sensing-dependent calculations before the required assets or tracking state were available, causing runtime exceptions. Other implementations checked for detected surfaces only at startup and did not respond when the surfaces became available later. This behavior also limited the functionality of some applications that passed the tests. For instance, in the lascaux-torch task shown in Figure 11 , successful implementations made virtual walls to simulate a cave whereas an XR developer might have developed shaders to place cave paintings on physical walls. These findings suggest a need for better handling of initialization dependencies and continuous sensing input throughout execution.
paragraphs.zh: 异步初始化与环境更新。 在失败运行中有44.9%出现了启动竞态条件。 一些实现在所需资源或追踪状态尚未就绪时就开始游戏逻辑更新或依赖感知的计算，导致运行时异常。 其他实现仅在启动时检查检测到的表面，当表面稍后才可用时未能做出响应。 这种行为还限制了一些通过了测试的应用程序的功能。 例如，在图11所示的 lascaux-torch 任务中，成功的实现制作了虚拟墙壁来模拟洞穴，而 XR 开发者可能会开发着色器，将洞穴壁画放置在物理墙壁上。 这些发现表明，需要在整个执行过程中更好地处理初始化依赖和持续的感知输入。

paragraphs.en: Coordinate transformations. Coordinate-frame errors occurred in 64.4% of failed runs. Implementations compared positions expressed relative to different parent objects without first transforming them to a common coordinate frame. This was especially apparent for objects parented by user transforms like the hand as is visible in Figure 14 where models anchored buttons directly to hands’ root joint rather than placing them onto the palm surface. These failures highlight recurring difficulties in maintaining a consistent spatial model of the physical world, the user, and virtual content in XR development.

paragraphs.en: Embodied interaction detection and usability. Current models still lack an embodied understanding of how humans exist and interact in XR and spatial computing settings. Agents often struggled with hand interactions and asymmetric hand gestures (34.5% of failures), accepting interactions from either hand interchangeably and failing to enforce separate tracking semantics. Other failures involved gesture recognition, as shown in Figure 12 , where candidate applications often failed to detect the framing pose. Agents often treated physical touch as a discrete click, relying on Boolean bounding-box intersections without tracking continuous penetration along surface normals. This often caused unstable contact detection during interactions. Finally, agents routinely failed to account for human ergonomics, placing interactive buttons out of comfortable reach, positioning menus behind the user, or rendering spatial UI at disproportionate scales, degrading ergonomic usability.
paragraphs.zh: 具身交互检测与可用性。 当前的模型仍然缺乏对人类在XR与空间计算环境中如何存在与交互的具身化理解。 智能体在手部交互和非对称手势上常常表现不佳（占失败的34.5%），会互换地接受来自任一只手的交互，且未能执行各自独立的追踪语义。 其他失败涉及手势识别，如图12所示，候选应用常常无法检测到取景姿势。 智能体常常把物理触碰当作离散的点击，依赖布尔包围盒相交判定，而不追踪沿表面法线的连续穿透。 这常导致交互过程中的接触检测不稳定。 最后，智能体经常未能考虑人体工学，将交互按钮放置在无法舒适触及的位置、把菜单放在用户背后，或以失衡的比例渲染空间UI，从而降低了人体工学可用性。

paragraphs.en: We present GenXR-Bench, the first benchmark to evaluate the functional and interactive correctness of agent-generated XR software. To create GenXR-Bench, five XR experts hand-wrote and curated 112 tasks spanning core XR engineering workflows within XR Blocks, using our novel automated XR testing framework, GenXR-Test. We find that frontier coding agents still struggle with XR development tasks, especially when tasks require continuous reasoning over embodied interactions and asynchronous XR runtime state. Our findings highlight the need to improve the embodied understanding of agents. We envision GenXR-Bench as a foundational testbed for advancing spatially situated software engineering across spatial AI, perception, and embodied interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 GenXR-Bench，这是首个用于评估智能体生成的 XR 软件在功能与交互正确性的基准。 为构建 GenXR-Bench，五位 XR 专家借助我们全新的自动化 XR 测试框架 GenXR-Test，手工编写并整理了 112 项任务，涵盖 XR Blocks 中的核心 XR 工程工作流。 我们发现，前沿编程智能体在 XR 开发任务上仍然表现不佳，尤其是当任务需要对具身交互和异步 XR 运行时状态进行持续推理时。 我们的发现凸显了提升智能体具身理解能力的必要性。 我们期望 GenXR-Bench 能成为一个基础性测试平台，推动跨空间 AI、感知与具身交互的空间化软件工程的发展。

paragraphs.en: This work investigates LLM-based code generation for XR applications to improve our understanding of how models reason about spatial computing and implement it in concrete applications. Our data collection was limited to real-world XR frameworks and was guided by contributors to ensure that all data is controlled and accessible. We take care to anonymize all potentially personally identifiable information. XR applications carry risks, including placing users at risk of physical harm by obscuring real-world hazards, so we limit our scope to safe, non-sensitive settings. All pretrained models used are publicly available and are used in accordance with their licenses. We believe our work contributes to the study of frontier coding capabilities.

paragraphs.en: GenXR-Bench is built on the XR Blocks framework ( Li et al., 2025 ) . We pin all benchmark tasks to a stable version of XR Blocks 0.21.0 , remove extraneous add-ons, and precache all runtime network downloads to support network-isolated execution in Harbor. The following XR Blocks features enable XR evaluations in simulated environments, which simplifies much of the complexity in other XR frameworks like Unity, Godot, or Unreal Engine that require in-depth understanding and usage of GUI features to run the engine. Instead, XR Blocks is implemented through common web frameworks like Three.js and WebXR. Thus, XR Blocks remains a strong environment to evaluate XR understanding and can be viewed as a viable native engine equivalent. The following XR Blocks capabilities enable simulated XR evaluations.

paragraphs.en: Articulated hand simulations. To simulate XR interactions accurately, we use the articulated hand simulations provided by XR Blocks. All poses are injected directly into the XR Blocks runtime to support standard gesture-recognition implementations and XR interaction logic in candidate applications.

paragraphs.en: Following the procedure in Appendix B , we collected 38 additional papers on formal evaluations of XR applications, for a total of 474 papers. Evaluators used each paper’s title and abstract to identify work that explicitly proposed or validated an evaluation tool. We excluded papers that used only generic off-the-shelf surveys ( e.g. , the System Usability Scale and NASA-TLX). We then downloaded all papers and analyzed them with Gemini Notebook to identify distinct evaluation variables that could be traced to a specific work. The identified heuristics were deduplicated, grouped, and mapped to Nielsen’s 10 usability heuristics to create XR-specific adaptations. We then rephrased the heuristics as declarative statements for scoring on a 1–5 Likert scale. We discarded candidate metrics that required specific hardware, were overly specific, or required human cognitive testing. Table 6 shows the final set of XR heuristics.
paragraphs.zh: 按照附录B中的流程，我们额外收集了38篇关于XR应用形式化评估的论文，共计474篇论文。 评估者根据每篇论文的标题和摘要，识别出明确提出或验证了评估工具的工作。 我们排除了仅使用通用现成量表的论文（例如，系统可用性量表和NASA-TLX）。 随后，我们下载了所有论文，并使用Gemini Notebook进行分析，以识别可以追溯到特定工作的独特评估变量。 对识别出的启发式原则进行去重、分组，并将其映射到Nielsen的10条可用性启发式原则上，以创建针对XR的适配版本。 然后，我们将这些启发式原则改写为陈述性语句，以便在1–5李克特量表上进行评分。 我们舍弃了需要特定硬件、过于具体或需要人类认知测试的候选指标。 表6展示了最终的XR启发式原则集合。

paragraphs.en: Although all test cases are human-written, GenXR-Bench also includes a VLM judge that evaluates application design and usability. A team of eight XR experts used a 1–5 Likert scale to rate the same 124 candidate apps generated by gemini-3.5-flash and gemini-3.7-flash across 62 app tasks ( Section 3.6 ). The experts evaluated each app based on the heuristics described in Table 6 . Because of the evaluation’s scale, the same set of three evaluators did not rate every candidate, which made traditional inter-rater agreement statistics inapplicable. Table 7 shows the results. paragraphs.en: Tables 8 , 9 , 11 and 10 report results by SDK subsystem and application domain, development tool usage, and XR design heuristic scores, respectively. Model configurations and reasoning settings are given in Section 4 . Model families each demonstrated different strengths. In SDK development tasks as seen in Table 8 , gpt-5.6-sol was the most capable of completing difficult input tasks that include hand and head gesture recognition while both gpt-5.6-sol and claude-opus-5 both demonstrated strong depth and rendering completion alongside. gemini-3.8-flash was the best at implementing various media input streams like camera and audio streams while gemini-3.6-flash and gemini-3.7-flash both had strong spatial perception performance. All models struggled with difficult UI implementation tasks, which required strong understanding of state management and XR interactions to effectively translate raycasts into 2D UI updates.

paragraphs.en: We use gemini-3.8-flash to judge each task run and analyze failures across all model runs. We then manually group the failures into three categories: environment and perception, user tracking, and general development. Because a single task can exhibit multiple failure modes, the percentages are computed across failed runs and are not mutually exclusive.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 gemini-3.8-flash 来评估每次任务运行，并分析所有模型运行中的失败情况。 随后我们将失败情况手动归为三类：环境与感知、用户追踪，以及一般开发。 由于单个任务可能表现出多种失败模式，这些百分比是基于失败运行计算的，且各类别并不互斥。

paragraphs.en: We acknowledge that our approach evaluating XR applications using a simulator is not 1:1 with on-device usage. While results in Table 2 and Table 7 demonstrate that evaluations are well aligned with human ratings, simulations still fail to capture physiological and accessibility constraints that can often affect human evaluations of XR experiences. Furthermore, XR Blocks simulates perfect sensor input which provides only a best case scenario for evaluations. On device, this is often far from the case where sensor input is noisy and incomplete. Addressing these issues can be viewed as a core part of XR development that is not addressed in this work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们承认，使用模拟器评估 XR 应用的方法与在设备上的实际使用并非完全一致。 尽管表 2 和表 7 的结果表明评估与人类评分高度一致，但模拟仍然无法捕捉生理和无障碍方面的限制，而这些限制往往会影响人类对 XR 体验的评价。 此外，XR Blocks 模拟的是完美的传感器输入，这只提供了评估中的最佳情况。 而在设备上，实际情况往往相去甚远，传感器输入通常带有噪声且不完整。 解决这些问题可以被视为 XR 开发的核心部分，但本工作并未涉及。
